items.title: 25.3 Dawa ki masnoaat ki synthesis (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the synthesis of pharmaceutical products (PDF 139-141).

blocks.text: Retrosynthesis ka ahem tareen istemal dawa ki masnoaat banane mein hai. Bohat si qeemti dawaiyon ki banawat pecheeda hai, lekin agar inhein durust aur mo'assar tareeqe se disconnect kiya jaye to yeh bohat saada, aam shuruati maaddon tak le jati hain.

blocks.alt: Phenol (benzene ring par HO), phir chaar chhote teer 'A series of steps', aur aakhir mein paracetamol: benzene ring par HO aur saamne wali position par N(H)-C(=O)-CH3.
blocks.caption: Paracetamol ki seedhi synthesis (kitab ke PDF safha 139 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Amide ka C-N bond torein: synthons HO-C6H4-NH- aur CH3CO+ hain.
Synthetic equivalents: 4-aminophenol aur ethanoyl (acyl) chloride; yeh nucleophilic addition-elimination se react karne ke liye maloom hain.
FGI: 4-aminophenol 4-nitrophenol se aata hai, jo aasani se banta aur reduce ho sakta hai.
4-nitrophenol ka C-N bond torein: synthons 4-hydroxyphenyl anion aur NO2+ hain.
Synthetic equivalents: phenol aur nitric acid.

blocks.alt: Paanch qadam. I: paracetamol ke amide C-N bond par katt, Disconnection se HO-C6H4-N(-)H synthon (A) aur +C(=O)CH3 synthon (B). II: synthon (A) = 4-aminophenol (SE); synthon (B) = acyl chloride (SE). III: 4-aminophenol, FGI khula teer, 4-nitrophenol. IV: 4-nitrophenol ke C-NO2 bond par katt se manfi charge wala HO-C6H4 synthon (A) aur NO2+ synthon (B). V: yeh phenol (SE) aur nitric acid HO-NO2 (SE) ke barabar.
blocks.caption: Paracetamol ki retrosynthesis, Steps I-V (kitab ke PDF safha 139-140 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Step III mein FGI ka teer khula (double) retrosynthetic teer hai, yani '4-aminophenol 4-nitrophenol se ban sakta hai'. Kitab ne yahan aam reaction wala teer chhapa hai, jo ulta matlab deta hai ke aminophenol se nitrophenol banta hai; is liye hum ne sahi retrosynthetic teer banaya. Kitab ke Step IV ke text mein '4-aminophenol' likha hai, magar jo molecule toota hai woh 4-nitrophenol hai, jaisa khaake mein hai.
Synthesis: phenol ki nitration se 4-nitrophenol (HNO3), nitro group ko Sn aur HCl se reduce kar ke 4-aminophenol, aur yeh ethanoyl chloride se react kar ke paracetamol, HO-C6H4-NHCOCH3, deta hai.

blocks.alt: Phenol, 'phenol (SM)', teer ke oopar HNO3 aur neeche H2SO4 se 4-nitrophenol; Sn + HCl se 4-aminophenol; neeche ki taraf teer CH3COCl se paracetamol, 'Paracetamol (TM)'.
blocks.caption: Paracetamol ki synthesis (kitab ke PDF safha 140 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Phenol ki nitration se 4-nitrophenol ke saath 2-nitrophenol bhi banta hai, jise alag kar liya jata hai. Phir Sn + HCl NO2 ko NH2 mein reduce karta hai, aur aakhir mein CH3COCl amino group ko amide (NHCOCH3) bana deta hai.

blocks.alt: Phenol, phir chaar chhote teer 'A series of steps', aur aakhir mein aspirin: benzene ring par COOH aur saath wale carbon par O-C(=O)-CH3.
blocks.caption: Aspirin ki seedhi synthesis (kitab ke PDF safha 140 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Ester ka C-O bond torein: synthons 2-carboxyphenoxide ion aur CH3CO+ hain.
Synthetic equivalents: salicylic acid (2-hydroxybenzoic acid) aur ethanoic (acetic) anhydride.
Salicylic acid ke carboxyl group ka C-C bond torein: synthons 2-hydroxyphenyl anion aur +COOH hain.
Synthetic equivalents: phenol aur carbon dioxide.

blocks.alt: Chaar qadam. I: aspirin (TM) ke ester O-C bond par katt, Disconnection se 2-carboxyphenoxide ion synthon (A) aur +C(=O)CH3 synthon (B). II: synthon (A) = salicylic acid (SE); synthon (B) = acetic anhydride (SE). III: salicylic acid ke ring-COOH bond par katt se OH ke saath wala ring carbanion (A) aur +C(=O)OH (B). IV: yeh phenol (SE) aur carbon dioxide O=C=O (SE) ke barabar.
blocks.caption: Aspirin ki retrosynthesis, Steps I-IV (kitab ke PDF safha 141 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Synthesis: phenol zyada darja hararat aur pressure par carbon dioxide se react karta, aur H2SO4 se tezaabi karne par salicylic acid milta; salicylic acid ko ethanoic anhydride aur H3PO4 catalyst ke saath garam karne se aspirin (aur ethanoic acid) banta hai. Amalan pehla qadam sodium phenoxide se kiya jata hai, jo phenol aur sodium hydroxide se banta hai.

blocks.alt: Phenol (SM), teer ke oopar (i) CO2, High T & P aur neeche (ii) H2SO4, se salicylic acid; agle teer ke oopar acetic anhydride aur neeche H3PO4, Heat, se Aspirin (TM).
blocks.caption: Aspirin ki synthesis (kitab ke PDF safha 141 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle qadam mein CO2 zyada darja hararat aur pressure par ring par COOH lagata hai (amal mein phenol ko pehle NaOH se sodium phenoxide banaya jata hai), aur H2SO4 se salicylic acid milta hai. Doosre qadam mein acetic anhydride salicylic acid ke OH ko ester (O-CO-CH3) bana deta hai; saath ethanoic acid bhi banta hai.

blocks.prompt: Aspirin aur paracetamol dono phenol se bante hain. Un mein functional groups ka kul farq kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Aspirin ke ring par carboxylic acid group aur ester group (OCOCH3) hain; paracetamol mein phenol -OH group aur amide group (NHCOCH3) hain.

blocks.prompt: In ki synthesis mein kaun sa FGI shamil hai?
blocks.explanation: Paracetamol: 4-nitrophenol ka nitro group amino group mein reduce hota (NO2 -> NH2). Aspirin: phenol ka -OH acylation se ester mein badalta (OH -> OCOCH3).

blocks.prompt: Dono tayyariyon mein kaun sa synthon mushtarka hai? Is ki banawat aur aam synthetic equivalent batayein.
blocks.explanation: Acylium (acetyl) cation, CH3CO+; is ka synthetic equivalent ethanoyl chloride, CH3COCl (ya ethanoic anhydride, (CH3CO)2O, jaisa aspirin ke liye).
